closeDialog.title: Close Window
closeDialog.message: Choose whether to minimize CyberPaste to the tray or exit it completely. Exiting stops clipboard capture and prevents scheduled automatic backups from running.

undoWarning.title: Pending undo actions
undoWarning.message: You have {{count}} deletion action(s) that can still be undone. If you close this window, these undo actions will be lost.

trayPinTip.title: Keep CyberPaste visible in the tray
trayPinTip.body: Windows hides new tray icons behind the overflow (^). Drag CyberPaste onto the taskbar, or pin it in Windows Settings.

compact.footerWithSelection: {{count}} selected · Ctrl+Enter COPY · Ctrl+P PIN · DEL DELETE

full.actionAutoInject: Copy to clipboard and simulate Ctrl+V
full.actionSelect: Click to select, press Enter or double-click to paste

clipList.emptyDesc: Copy something to your clipboard and it will appear here.
clipList.noResultsDesc: Try another search or clear the active search.

folders.copyToFolderHint: Arrows to choose, Enter to copy, Esc to close
folders.iconHelper: Select an icon for your folder

settings.title: Configuration
settings.aiConfigurationDesc: Connect a provider with your API key so CyberPaste can summarize, translate, explain code, and fix grammar from the clip menu.
settings.customPromptsDesc: Leave blank to use default prompts. Click a row to edit; click the name to rename the menu action.
settings.scrollDirectionDesc: Clip list scroll direction in full view
settings.compactSidebarCollapsedDesc: Hide sidebar to maximize clip list space
settings.compactViewPositionDesc: Where the window appears when opened via hotkey
settings.clipboardSoundDesc: Play a sound when a new clip is captured
settings.startupSoundDesc: Play a sound when the application starts
settings.launchAtLoginDesc: Start automatically when logging into Windows
settings.keepVisibleInTray: Keep CyberPaste visible in the tray
settings.keepVisibleInTrayDesc: Windows hides new tray icons behind the overflow (^). Drag CyberPaste onto the taskbar, or pin it in Windows Settings.
settings.keepVisibleInTrayTooltip: Open the Windows page where you can pin CyberPaste to the visible tray.
settings.showAppRecommendationsDesc: Show the CyberGems suite in About and the tray menu.
settings.accessibilityPermissionDesc: Required for Auto-Paste to work on macOS
settings.roundCornersDesc: Round window corners via DWM (Windows 11). No effect on Clear mode.
settings.autoPasteDesc: Paste into the previous app after selection, then close CyberPaste (unless pinned)
settings.singleClickPasteDesc: When enabled, clicking a clip pastes immediately. When disabled, click selects; press Enter or double-click to paste.
settings.autoInjectPasteDesc: When Auto Paste is enabled, use Ctrl+V instead of Shift+Insert
settings.resetViewOnPaste: Reset search and view on show / paste
settings.resetViewOnPasteDesc: Clears active search, resets selected folder to the main clipboard, and scrolls to top when opening the window or pasting a clip
settings.typeToSearchDesc: Start typing anywhere to instantly search clips in real time
settings.wheelFolderNavigationDesc: Navigate folder contents by scrolling the mouse wheel over tabs
settings.compactPeekEnabledDesc: Display a detailed overlay preview with metadata when hovering over rows
settings.clipNumberingDesc: How clip numbers are displayed in the list
settings.pauseMonitoringDesc: Temporarily stop capturing new clipboard items
settings.viewModeHotkeyDesc: Shortcut to switch between full and compact views
settings.compactAutoHeightDesc: Automatically adjust compact window height based on content
settings.compactShowSourceIconDesc: Show the icon of the program where the clip was copied from
settings.compactShowTimeDesc: Display when the clip was copied next to the icons
settings.compactShowTypeIconDesc: Show the icon representing the content type (text, code, image, etc.)
settings.compactShowNumberDesc: Show positional index number on the left side of the row
settings.compactShowScrollbarDesc: Show the thin scrollbar for the compact clip list
settings.fullGridScaleDesc: Set the size of cards in the grid
settings.fullGridColumnsDesc: Use an automatic number of columns or keep a fixed grid width
settings.fullScrollDirectionDesc: Choose how to move through clips
settings.fullPeekEnabledDesc: Display an expanded overlay preview with high-res image and metadata when hovering over cards
settings.fullShowHudDesc: Show keyboard shortcut hints and database size in the title bar
settings.fullShowSourceIconDesc: Show the application icon associated with each clip
settings.fullShowTimeDesc: Show when each clip was captured
settings.fullShowTypeIconDesc: Show the icon representing the clip content type
settings.fullShowNumberDesc: Show the positional number of each clip
settings.fullShowScrollbarDesc: Show the thin scrollbar for the full clip grid
settings.ignoredAppsDesc: Don't capture clipboard from these apps (browse for the executable, or type the name and press Enter)
settings.clipboardTextLimitDesc: Maximum size for text, URLs, code, HTML, and rich text captured from the clipboard.
settings.clipboardImageLimitDesc: Maximum encoded PNG size for new clipboard images. Images above 50 megapixels are always rejected.
settings.storageQuotaDesc: Maximum active clipboard storage, including the database and referenced image files. Backups are excluded.
settings.clearHistoryMessage: This will delete all clips in the main Clipboard. Clips inside your folders are safe and will NOT be deleted.
settings.clearHistorySuccess: Clipboard history cleared. Folder contents preserved.
settings.aiTranslatePlaceholder: Default: Detect language — Spanish to English, English to Spanish, else to English.
settings.checkForUpdatesDesc: Check for the latest version and download updates directly.
settings.updateErrorHint: You can still download the latest version from GitHub Releases.
settings.updatesNewVersionAvailable: A new version of CyberPaste is available!
settings.updatesSkipError: Could not skip this version. Please try again.
settings.updatesErrorDesc: Could not download the update. Please check your internet connection or try downloading manually.
settings.autoCheckUpdatesDesc: Automatically check for updates on startup
settings.showActionMessagesDesc: Show feedback messages like 'Opening Viewer', 'Processing' or 'Enabled'
settings.duplicateToastsDesc: Show a toast and play its sound when a copied clip already exists.
settings.quietHoursDesc: Only critical alerts appear during this schedule. Status messages, achievements, and other results stay silent.
settings.quietHoursScheduleDesc: Uses local time. Overnight ranges such as 22:00 to 07:00 are supported.
settings.toastClickActionDesc: What happens when you click the notification toast
settings.toastPositionDesc: Select toast notification placement on the screen
settings.testToastMsg: This is how your notifications will look!
settings.toastMonitorDesc: Choose which monitor to show notifications on.
settings.toastDurationDesc: Select how long the notification remains visible.
settings.testNotificationDesc: Sends a test toast to check position and duration.
settings.languageDesc: Choose your preferred language for CyberPaste.
settings.aboutDescription: A fast, local clipboard history manager built for focused workflows, with instant search and privacy by default.
settings.aboutIssuesTooltip: Report a bug or open an issue
settings.themeDesc: Choose the signature appearance of CyberPaste, dark, light, or follow your Windows theme.
settings.externalImageEditorDesc: Path to your favorite viewer (e.g., CyberViewer). If empty, the default Windows viewer will be used.
settings.historyLimitDesc: Maximum number of clips to keep in history (excludes folders).
settings.appLockDesc: Hide the clipboard window behind a PIN or password. This does not encrypt files on disk.
settings.appLockWarning: Anyone with access to this Windows account can still read CyberPaste data in AppData. Use this to hide the history from someone using your PC, not as a vault.
settings.appLockRecovery: If you forget your PIN or password, use the recovery key shown when you turned the lock on. You can create a new key here anytime while the app is unlocked. Keep it in a password manager or a safe note.
settings.appLockRecoveryLastResort: If the recovery key is also lost, fully quit CyberPaste from the tray and start it once with --reset-lock.
settings.appLockRecoveryKeyBody: This is the only in-app way to unlock CyberPaste if you forget your PIN or password. CyberPaste will not show this key again.
settings.appLockRecoveryKeySaved: I saved this recovery key in a safe place
settings.appLockRecoveryKeyMissing: No recovery key is saved yet. Enter your current PIN or password above, then create one so you are not stuck if you forget it.
settings.appLockRecoveryKeyNeedSecret: Enter your current PIN or password first.
settings.appLockRecoveryKeyCreatedToast: Save the new recovery key before you close this window
settings.appLockOnHideDesc: Recommended. The history is used in short bursts, so this is the main protection.
settings.appLockOnWindowsLockDesc: Lock CyberPaste when you lock the PC or switch session.
settings.appLockIdleDesc: Locks CyberPaste when you stop interacting with its window for the selected time, even if it remains visible.
settings.appLockPauseCaptureDesc: By default, CyberPaste still records copies while the UI is locked.
settings.appLockDisableNeedSecret: Enter your current PIN or password to turn off the lock.
settings.apiKeySaved: API key saved on this Windows account
settings.panicRoomDesc: If the window becomes deformed, off-screen, or behaves erratically, use this to restore all layout and visibility settings to factory defaults.
settings.backupDesc: * Export saves all clips, images, folders, and settings. Import replaces everything with the backup data.
settings.autoBackupDesc: Creates one backup per day while CyberPaste is running and keeps only the most recent files.
settings.autoBackupFolderOpenFailed: Could not open the backup folder.
settings.autoBackupRetentionDesc: Older automatic backups are removed only after a new backup is saved successfully.
settings.autoBackupNowDesc: Create a fresh backup without waiting for the daily schedule.
settings.autoBackupFailed: Automatic backup failed. Previous backups were kept.
settings.loadDemoClipsMessage: This will temporarily show 7 example clips in place of your current view. Your real clips are NOT deleted and will return on restart or when you click Restore.
settings.systemDebugDesc: Access data storage. Useful for advanced troubleshooting or manual backups.
settings.storageUsageDesc: Database and referenced image files compared with the configured quota.
settings.databaseSizeDesc: Current size of the local clip history database.
settings.storageImagesDesc: Space used by full-size clipboard images.
settings.titleBarAnimationDesc: Subtle scan-line sweep light animation across the window header
settings.openSourceDesc: CyberPaste is built with passion and open-source technologies like Rust, Tauri, and React.
settings.importBackupMessage: This will REPLACE all current clips, folders, images, and settings with the backup data. Your current data will be lost. Export a backup first if you want to keep it.
settings.restoreComplete: Restore complete! CyberPaste has been updated.
settings.updateNotReachable: Could not reach the update service.
settings.achievementsSectionDesc: Build a personal collection of milestones while keeping your progress completely local.
settings.achievementsLocalOnlyDesc: Your achievements and progress stay on this device. CyberPaste does not send analytics, telemetry, clips, or usage data to CyberGems.
settings.progressInstalledOnDesc: For existing profiles, this uses the earliest reliable profile timestamp available.
settings.achievementsUnavailable: Progress is not available right now.
settings.enableAchievementsDesc: Keep track of personal milestones on this device. Disabling this stops new progress without deleting existing data.
settings.achievementNotificationsDesc: Show a small notification when a new achievement is unlocked.
settings.resetProgressDesc: Deletes achievements and progress counters, but does not delete your clips.
settings.resetProgressConfirm: Reset all local achievements and progress? Your clipboard history will remain untouched.

editor.title: Text Editor
editor.saveShortcutHint: Ctrl+Enter or Ctrl+S to save · Esc to cancel

ai.apiKeyMissing: The AI API key is missing from Settings.

toasts.cannotPinLatestClip: The latest clip can't be pinned
toasts.configureEditor: Please configure an External Image Editor (like CyberViewer) in Settings to use this feature.
toasts.duplicateMessage: The clip was not copied again.
toasts.contentLimitExceeded: This clipboard content was not saved because it exceeds the {{limit}} text capture limit.
toasts.imageLimitExceeded: This image ({{size}}) was not saved because it exceeds the {{limit}} image capture limit.
toasts.imagePixelLimitExceeded: This image ({{width}} × {{height}}) was not saved because it exceeds the 50 megapixel safety limit.
toasts.storageQuotaPruned: Storage quota reached. Removed {{count}} oldest eligible clips. Folders and pinned clips were preserved.
toasts.storageQuotaUnmet: Storage quota is still exceeded. No more eligible clips can be removed because folders and pinned clips are protected.

confirm.deletePinnedMessage: This clip is pinned. Are you sure you want to delete it?
confirm.deletePinnedBulkMessage: The selection contains pinned clips. Are you sure you want to delete them?

viewer.title: Image Viewer
viewer.noEditorConfigured: Set an image editor in Settings first
viewer.noImagePath: Image file is not available yet

appLock.unlockSubtitle: Enter your PIN or password to see clipboard history.
appLock.tryAgainIn: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.
appLock.forgotBody: Enter the recovery key you saved when you turned the lock on, then choose a new PIN or password.
appLock.setNewSecret: Set a new PIN or password

errors.invalid: That PIN or password is not correct.
errors.invalidRecovery: That recovery key is not correct.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.weak: Use a 4 to 8 digit PIN, or a password of at least 6 characters.
errors.noRecoveryKey: No recovery key was saved on this device. Unlock with your PIN or password.
errors.mismatch: The two values do not match.
